about: One short line per skill for menus in the plugin. The full description in each SKILL.md becomes when_to_use, which the agent still reads when choosing a skill. Keep each under 70 characters and free of the studio name.
buck-lighting-v01: First lighting pass on a shot.
buck-lighting-transfer: Carry approved lighting to another shot.
buck-lighting-render: Full-range farm render of an approved version.
buck-lighting-handoff: Hand a lighting scene to another artist.
buck-lighting-variations: Lighting options for one creative question.
buck-lighting-sources: Update animation, camera or asset versions in a shot.
buck-lighting-aovs: Render layers, AOVs and mattes for comp.
buck-lighting-optimize: Cut render time, noise or memory.
buck-lighting-coverage: QA lighting across the whole shot.
buck-lighting-diagnose: Find why a render looks wrong.
buck-lighting-previews: Farm test frames of a lighting change.
buck-modeling-production: Take an approved blockout to final.
buck-modeling-modular: Build a kit of pieces that fit together.
buck-modeling-handoff: Hand a model to another modeler.
buck-modeling-variations: Shape options for one design decision.
buck-modeling-reference-update: Change a model that shots already reference.
buck-modeling-reference-check: Compare a model against its reference.
buck-modeling-readiness: Check a model is ready for the next department.
buck-pipeline-aquarium: Look up job facts and task ids in the tracker.
buck-pipeline-farm: Write, submit and check farm render jobs.
buck-pipeline-launch: Run Maya or Nuke headless in the job's environment.
buck-pipeline-status: Report what this session is working on.
buck-pipeline-setup: Set up a job's Agents folder and install skills.
buck-pipeline-trail: Save a version and write its .trail record.
